unsupported_effort_note: For gemini-3.7-flash, thinking is supported at low, medium, and high levels; minimal is not supported and returns an error.

skill_isolation.limitation_note: Skills are staged into the self-contained plugin tree; skill-level isolation relies on repository and workspace boundaries since Antigravity loads plugin skills into the active session context.

subagents.note: Custom subagents are defined as Markdown manifests under agents/ and dispatched via Antigravity's subagent mechanism.

worktrees.limitation_note: Git worktree switching within a single session is not supported natively; Workcell uses external jj workspaces (workcell-ws) to isolate parallel agent worktrees.

command_hooks.note: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop command hooks are supported natively via hooks.json and invoke shared guards.

teamwork.omission_note: Teamwork is a paid, interactive multi-agent orchestration surface available only in Antigravity interactive sessions; in headless mode (`agy -p`), Workcell relies on the standard async headless fallback via independent CLI invocations in isolated workspaces or custom subagents.
